# @cortex-ui/agents-card-agents

Running agents in the card: stage, speed, elapsed, contract checks, own diff; steer and stop.

- **Plugin id:** `agents.card-agents`
- **Slot:** `card.agents@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `card.agents@1` as `agents.card-agents`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Workbench state written:** `projectId`, `sessionId`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** none
- **Frame methods called:** `agents.list`, `frame.journal.read`, `memory.task.list`
- **Topics followed:** `agents.changed`, `journal.<session>`, `memory.task.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
